title: Transactions, Error Handling & Backup
description: Transaction management, error handling with TRY/CATCH and RAISERROR, backup strategies (full, differential, transaction log), recovery models, and database snapshots.
longDescription: This module covers transaction management, error handling, and backup strategies in SQL Server. You'll learn about transactions, control-of-flow statements, TRY/CATCH error handling, backup types, recovery models, and database snapshots.
whatYouLearn: Manage transactions with BEGIN, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK
Use control-of-flow statements (IF/ELSE, BEGIN/END, WHILE, BREAK, CONTINUE)
Raise custom errors with RAISERROR and THROW
Create full, differential, and transaction log backups
